summary: Frontend-only focused verification completed for the hero unpinned scroll behavior on public preview, including desktop/mobile checks and a REAL WebKit spot-check.
critical_code_review_comments: Hero is no longer pinned: computed position is relative and hero top tracks native scroll (e.g., scrollY 180 -> hero top -180).
Track height equals hero height in both desktop and mobile checks, so services follow immediately without added runway.
Frame scrub progresses and reverses with scroll direction in Chromium and REAL WebKit spot-check after settle (desktop and mobile).
Motion toggle does not alter document height and does not reintroduce sticky behavior.
Leistungen anchor remains reachable (#leistungen hash set; services section near viewport top).
context_for_next_testing_agent: This run validated the latest UX requirement (normal immediate page scrolling with frame scrub, no sticky/pin) on https://subtle-motion-8.preview.emergentagent.com using both browser automation and a REAL WebKit script. WebKit check output is in /app/test_reports/artifacts/iteration_7/webkit_quick_results.json.
rca of the issue: No regression reproduced in this iteration. Prior Safari-like concern was not observed in this environment after allowing adequate frame-load settle time during WebKit checks.
